blocks.content: Whoever fails to comply with any provision of this Act, for which no penalty has been separately provided, shall be liable to pay a penalty not exceeding twenty-five thousand rupees.

rows: Damage or unauthorized access to computer systems
Failure to furnish report, return, or information
Penalty up to ₹1,50,000 or ₹5,000 per day

items: The residuary penalty under Section 45 carries a maximum fine cap of ₹25,000.
Adjudicating Officers under Section 46 must hold a rank not below Director to the Government of India or State equivalent.
Section 43A specifically addresses corporate negligence in protecting sensitive personal data.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Section 43 mandates compensation to affected parties for unauthorized access, downloading, or damaging computer systems.
Section 43A establishes corporate liability for failure to implement reasonable security practices to protect sensitive personal data.
Section 44 prescribes statutory penalties for failure to furnish required documents, returns, or information within specified time limits.
Section 45 serves as the residuary penalty clause, prescribing a fine of up to ₹25,000 where no specific penalty is provided.
Section 46 empowers an Adjudicating Officer, not below the rank of Director to the Government of India or State equivalent, to hold inquiries.
